description: Follows Emma Bovary’s desires, debts, and relationships and examines free indirect style, consumer aspiration, and provincial life. Covers Voice, Free Indirect Style, and Irony; Reading, Romantic Scripts, and Disappointment; Marriage, Desire, and Gendered Constraints; The 1857 Trial, Translations, and Influence.
